fields.label: auto
fields.value: check: automatic on startup + notify dialog. download: user click in `AppUpdateDownloadDialog`. run: optional user checkbox "run after download"

fields.label: downloads_and_executes
fields.value: Y (Windows: `run_downloaded_file`→`run_file`→`GUI::create_process` launches the downloaded installer if user opted in; macOS just mounts the dmg for manual install)

fields.label: transport
fields.value: https (files.prusa3d.com); TLS not overridden — no `CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER`/`VERIFYHOST` disable found in `Http.cpp` (only `CURLSSLOPT_REVOKE_BEST_EFFORT` set) → enforced by curl default

fields.label: payload_verification
